entries.jp: 天歌で人心を操ろうとした\n徳川の亡霊の野望が\n潰えてから数か月――
entries.en:
Several months
had passed since
the Tokugawa
ghosts' plot to
control hearts
with Heaven's
Song was
crushed--

entries.jp:
自由な音楽を
手にした人々は
憂いなく平和に
暮らしていた
entries.en:
With music
freed, the people
lived in peace,
without a care.

entries.jp:
あれから
ロック修行の旅へと
出ていた龍馬であったが
久しぶりに江戸の地へと
訪れていた
entries.en:
Ryoma, who had
since set out on
a journey of rock
training, had
come to Edo for
the first time in
a long while.

entries.jp: あいかわらず江戸の街は\n活気があるぜよ！
entries.en: Edo's as\nlively as ever!

entries.jp: それにしても\n何だかえらい騒ぎじゃな
entries.en:
Still, there's
a mighty big
commotion
goin' on.

entries.jp: 新選組の雷舞でも\nあるのか？
entries.en:
Is the
Shinsengumi
puttin' on a live
or somethin'?

entries.jp: あっらぁ～！\n龍ちゃんじゃない！\n久しぶりねぇ～
entries.en: Oh my~! If it isn't\nRyo-chan! It's\nbeen so looong~!

entries.jp: お　お登勢やん
entries.en: O-Otose-yan!

entries.jp: 抱擁（ハグ）しちゃいましょ！\nぎゅっぎゅっぎゅ～！
entries.en:
Let's have a
hug! Squeeze,
squeeze,
squeeeeze~!

entries.jp: ふ　ふごっ\n息が　出来んぜよ……
entries.en: Mmph! Fwgh! I\ncan't breathe...

entries.jp: きゃーっっ！\n龍ちゃんっ\nしっかりして！
entries.en: Kyaaah! Ryo-chan!\nHang in there!

entries.jp: まったく\n何をやってるんだか
entries.en: Honestly.\nWhat are you\neven doing?

entries.jp: 相変わらずですね……
entries.en: Same as ever...

entries.jp: でも～　\n坂本さんらしいですぅ～
entries.en: But~ that's so like\nSakamoto-saaan~

entries.jp: おお　暗黒桜桃隊の\nみんなもおるんか！\n久しぶりじゃなぁ！
entries.en:
Oh! The Dark
Cherries are all
here too! Been
a long time!

entries.jp: でも　どうして江戸に\nおるんじゃ？
entries.en: But what're you\nall doin' in Edo?

entries.jp: 江戸にテラーダの支店を\n出すことになってね\nみんなで下見に来たのさ
entries.en:
We're opening
a branch of
the Terada in
Edo, y'see, so
we all came to
scout it out.

entries.jp: テラーダが江戸にも\nできるんか！
entries.en: There's gonna\nbe a Terada\nin Edo too!?

entries.jp: んふっ\nそうなのよ
entries.en: Hehe~\nThat's right!

entries.jp: 美味し～いピッツァを\n江戸の人達にも\n食べて欲しいもの
entries.en:
I want the people
of Edo to taste
my deee-licious
pizza too!

entries.jp: そりゃあいい！\nお登勢やんのぴっつぁは\nマジでうまいからな！
entries.en:
That's great!
Otose-yan's
pitsa is seriously
delicious!

entries.jp: ところで坂本さんはぁ\n何をしてるんですぅ？
entries.en:
By the way,
Sakamoto-saaan,
what are
you up to?

entries.jp: 今も修行の旅の途中ぜよ\n江戸にはちょっと寄った\nだけじゃ
entries.en:
I'm still on my
training journey.
Just droppin' by
Edo for a bit.

entries.jp: ちょうどシンディと\nセンセーも　江戸に\nいるらしいと聞いてな
entries.en:
I heard Shindy
and Sensei
happen to be
in Edo too, see.

entries.jp: あらっ　晋ちゃん達も\n江戸に来てるの？
entries.en: Oh! Shin-chan\nand the others\nare in Edo too?

entries.jp: おう　勝のおっさんの家で\nロックと政治の勉強中って\n聞いとるぜよ
entries.en:
Yup. Heard
they're studyin'
rock and politics
at old man
Katsu's place.

entries.jp: 今から挨拶に行くんじゃが\nお登勢やん達も一緒に\n行かんか？
entries.en:
I'm headin' over
to say hello now.
Why don't you
all come along,
Otose-yan?

entries.jp: そうね　せっかくだし\n一緒に行きましょう！
entries.en: Well, since we're\nhere anyway,\nlet's go together!

entries.jp: えぇ～……\nお龍姐さん達とぉ\n江戸見物の予定がぁ～
entries.en:
Awww... But I was
gonna go
sightseeing in
Edo with Sis Oryo
and the others~

entries.jp: まあまあ　おうの\nいいじゃないの
entries.en: Now, now, Ouno.\nIt's fine, isn't it?

entries.jp: 勝先生に挨拶しておけば……\nテラーダの江戸支店も\n先生のお墨付きよ……
entries.en:
If we pay our
respects to
Katsu-sensei...
the Terada's
Edo branch will
have his seal
of approval...

entries.jp: さっ　行きましょう～\n坂本さぁん♪
entries.en: Come on, let's go~\nSakamoto-saaan~

entries.jp: お　おう……\nそれじゃあ行くぜよ
entries.en: R-right... Let's\nget goin', then.

entries.jp: 違う違う違うっ！\nオレ様の求める音は\nこんなんじゃねえ！
entries.en:
No, no, NO!
That is NOT
the sound yours
truly is after!

entries.jp: もう一度だ
entries.en: One more time.

entries.jp: う～ん\n休憩にしませんか？\n朝からぶっ通しですよ
entries.en:
Hmm... Shall we
take a break?
We've been at
it nonstop
since morning.

entries.jp: 何言ってんだ　桂さん\nせっかく勝先生の屋敷に\nいるんだぞ？
entries.en:
What are you
saying,
Katsura-san?
We're actually
staying at
Katsu-sensei's
mansion!

entries.jp: この宝の山みたいな\n楽譜を見て練習しない\n理由はないだろう！
entries.en:
With a treasure
trove of sheet
music like this,
there's no reason
not to practice!

entries.jp: 見ろよ　これなんて\n松陰先生の直筆だぜ！\nくぅ　シビれるなあ！
entries.en:
Look at this
one! It's in
Shoin-sensei's
own hand!
Man, that
gives me chills!

entries.jp: 晋作の気持ちもわかりますが\n政治の勉強もしっかりと\nしないとまずいでしょう
entries.en:
I understand
how you feel,
Shinsaku, but
we really ought
to study politics
properly too.

entries.jp: 頼もーう！
entries.en: Ho there, within!\nI request entry!

entries.jp: もうっ　龍ちゃん\nそれじゃ道場破りでしょ
entries.en:
Oh, Ryo-chan!
You sound like
you've come to
challenge a dojo!

entries.jp: なんだ？\n聞き覚えのある声が\n聞こえたと思ったら
entries.en: What? I thought\nI heard a\nfamiliar voice...

entries.jp: シンディ！
entries.en: Shindy!

entries.jp: うおっ！　龍馬！\nこのバカ！\n抱きつくんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Whoa! Ryoma!\nYou idiot!\nDon't hug me!

entries.jp: わしとシンディの\n仲じゃないか\n照れることはないぜよ～
entries.en:
Come on, Shindy,
after all you and
me've been
through? No
need to be shy~

entries.jp: 照れてねえ！\n放しやがれ！\n暑苦しい
entries.en: I'm not shy! Let\ngo of me! Too\nhot, get off!

entries.jp: 晋作\nどうしました？\nお客さんですか？
entries.en: Shinsaku, what's\ngoing on? Do we\nhave guests?

entries.jp: センセー\n元気にしてたか？
entries.en: Sensei! You\nbeen doin' well?

entries.jp: わわっ　龍馬くん！　\nそれにお登勢さんも！
entries.en: Wah!\nRyoma-kun! And\nOtose-san too!

entries.jp: ぁたし達もぉ\nいますよぉ～
entries.en: We're here toooo~

entries.jp: 桂さん！\nこのバカを\nどうにかしてくれ！
entries.en: Katsura-san!\nDo something\nabout this idiot!

entries.jp: 素直に　再会できて\n嬉しいって言えば\nいいんです
entries.en:
You just need to
be honest and
say you're happy
to see him again.

entries.jp: 嬉しくねえ！
entries.en: I'm not happy!

entries.jp: 晋作は　ずっと\n龍馬くんのことを\n心配していたんですよ
entries.en:
Shinsaku has
been worried
about you this
whole time,
Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: おお！　シンディは\nわしのことを心配して\nくれとったんか？
entries.en: Oh! Shindy, you\nwere worried\nabout me?

entries.jp: うるせぇ！\n放せ！\n解散だ
entries.en: Shut up! Let\ngo! We're\nbreaking up!

entries.jp: はいはい　晋作\n落ち着いて
entries.en: Yes, yes,\nShinsaku.\nCalm down.

entries.jp: なんでオレ様だけ
entries.en: Why's it always\njust me...

entries.jp: それにしても\nどうしたんですか？\nみなさんお揃いで
entries.en:
Anyway, what
brings you
here? All of you
together, too.

entries.jp: アタシ達は江戸支店の\n下見さね
entries.en: We're just here\nscouting out the\nEdo branch, is all.

entries.jp: わしはひさびさに二人の\n顔が見たくなってなあ
entries.en:
And me, I just
got to missin'
you two's faces
after so long.

entries.jp: それはいいけどよ\nどうしてお前一人なんだ\n岩崎も一緒だっただろ
entries.en:
That's fine and
all, but why are
you alone?
Iwasaki was with
you, wasn't he?

entries.jp: お？　弥太郎か？\n途中ではぐれたぜよ
entries.en: Oh? Yataro? We\ngot separated\nalong the way.

entries.jp: 旅の途中　川で魚を\n捕るとか言い出して\n滝に呑まれていった
entries.en:
On the road, he
said he was
gonna catch
fish in a river,
and got swept
over a waterfall.

entries.jp: おいおい……
entries.en: Oh, come on...

entries.jp: わしも弥太郎を\n助けようと思ったんじゃが\n一緒に滝から落ちての
entries.en:
I tried to save
Yataro too, but
I went over the
falls right
along with him.

entries.jp: 気がついたら一人きり\nだったんで　一人で\n江戸まで来たぜよ！
entries.en:
When I came to,
I was all alone,
so I came to
Edo by myself!

entries.jp: や　弥太郎くん\n大丈夫ですかね？
entries.en: Y-Yataro-kun...\nDo you think\nhe's all right?

entries.jp: わしが無事だったんじゃ\nあいつも平気じゃろ
entries.en: If I came out\nfine, he's\nprob'ly fine too.

entries.jp: それに　わしら\nあの程度の滝なら\n落ち慣れているぜよ
entries.en:
Besides, we're
used to fallin'
off waterfalls
that size.

entries.jp: 滝っちゅうもんは\n落ちてみなければ\nデカさがわからんじゃろ
entries.en:
You can't tell how
big a waterfall is
till you fall off it,
right?

entries.jp: お前ら　本当に\nバカなんだな……
entries.en: You two really\nare idiots...

entries.jp: ともあれ\n二人とも元気そうで\n安心したぜよ！
entries.en:
Anyhow, I'm
relieved to
see you both
doin' well!

entries.jp: 二人の顔を見たら\n雷舞をやりたくなって\nきたのう
entries.en: Seein' your faces\nsure makes me\nwanna do a live!

entries.jp: ハン　そんなこと言って\n修行が辛くて逃げ帰って\nきたんじゃねえのか？
entries.en:
Hah. Talk all
you want. Didn't
you just come
running home
because training
got too tough?

entries.jp: おお～\nシンディじゃ！
entries.en: Ohhh~ That's\nShindy, all right!

entries.jp: はぁっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: いや　その憎まれ口を\n聞くとシンディじゃなぁと
entries.en:
Nah, hearin' that
smart mouth of
yours, I just
thought, "Yep,
that's Shindy."

entries.jp: てめぇ\nオレ様のことを\n何だと思ってやがる
entries.en: You bastard...\nWhat do you take\nyours truly for?

entries.jp: シンディは\nシンディぜよ！
entries.en: Shindy's Shindy!

entries.jp: まあまあ\nいいじゃないですか\nシンディ
entries.en: Now, now,\nwhat's the harm?\nRight, Shindy?

entries.jp: か　桂さんまで
entries.en: K-Katsura-san,\nyou too!?

entries.jp: それにしても\n江戸で雷舞ですか
entries.en: Still, a live\nin Edo, is it?

entries.jp: 龍馬くんのことだから\nジュニアに挑戦……\nといったところですか？
entries.en:
Knowing you,
Ryoma-kun,
you're planning to
challenge Junior...
something like
that?

entries.jp: ほへ？　じゅにあ？\n何じゃ　それは？\n食いもんの名前か？
entries.en: Huh? Juh-nee-uh?\nWhat's that? Some\nkinda food?

entries.jp: はぁぁ\nお前　ジュニアを\n知らないのか
entries.en: Haaah... You don't\nknow Junior?

entries.jp: うっそぉぉ！\n龍ちゃん　ジュニア様を\n知らないの？
entries.en:
No waaay!
Ryo-chan, you
don't know
Junior-sama?

entries.jp: な　なんじゃなんじゃ？\nじゅにあっちゅうんは\nそんなにうまいのか？
entries.en:
Wh-what, what?
Is this
juh-nee-uh stuff
really that tasty?

entries.jp: ジュニアというのは\n今　話題のロックスター\nですよ
entries.en:
Junior is the rock
star everyone's
talking about
right now.

entries.jp: 本名は　マシュー\nカルブレイス\nペリージュニア
entries.en:
His real name
is Matthew
Calbraith
Perry Junior.

entries.jp: 巷では　ジュニアと\n呼ばれています
entries.en: Around town,\npeople call\nhim Junior.

entries.jp: ま　ましゅぅ……\nずいぶんと長い名前ぜよ\n舌を噛みそうじゃ
entries.en:
M-Mathooo...
That's one
long name! I'd
bite my tongue
tryin' to say it.

entries.jp: 異国ではそれが\n普通なんだって　何だか\nカッコイイじゃないか
entries.en:
I hear that's
normal in foreign
lands. Kinda cool,
isn't it?

entries.jp: メリケンから黒船で\nやってきた　本場の\nロックスターなのよ
entries.en:
He's a real-deal
rock star who
came over from
America on the
Black Ships.

entries.jp: 何？　\n本場のロック
entries.en: What?\nReal-deal rock?

entries.jp: あの力強い声……\n色気のある歌……
entries.en: That powerful\nvoice... those\nsexy songs...

entries.jp: 聴いてるとぉ～\nシビれちゃいますぅ～
entries.en: When I listen~\nit gives me\nthe shiiivers~

entries.jp: おや　お登勢さん達も\n雷舞を聴いたんですか？
entries.en: Oh? Otose-san,\nyou all went to\nhear his live too?

entries.jp: 江戸に来てすぐにね\nホント　よかったわぁ～
entries.en: Right after we\ngot to Edo! It\nwas sooo good~

entries.jp: 身も心も\n熱くなっちゃった！
entries.en: It got me all hot,\nbody and soul!

entries.jp: アタシらも一瞬で虜さ\nあんなすごいロックは\n初めて聴いたね
entries.en:
We were
hooked in an
instant. Never
heard rock that
amazing before.

entries.jp: さすが本場は違います……
entries.en: The real deal\nreally is\nsomething else...

entries.jp: ジュニア様にならぁ～\n抱かれてもいいかもぉ～\nぽっ
entries.en:
For Junior-sama~
I might even let
him hold me~
*blush*

entries.jp: そんなに\nすごいヤツなんか\nじゅにあってのは
entries.en: He's that\namazin', huh?\nThis Junior fella?

entries.jp: ふんっ　実力は認めるが\nオレ様の敵じゃねえ
entries.en:
Hmph. I'll admit
he's got skill, but
he's no match
for yours truly.

entries.jp: シンディがそう言うって\nことは　本当にすごい\n奴なんじゃな
entries.en:
If Shindy's
sayin' that, then
he must really
be somethin'!

entries.jp: ええ　龍馬くんも一度\n雷舞を聴きに行くと\nいいですよ
entries.en:
Yes. You
should go hear
one of his live
shows yourself,
Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: わしも本場のロックを\n聴いてみたいぜよ！
entries.en:
I wanna hear
some real rock
from where it
was born, too!

entries.jp: まだ見ぬ強敵に思いを馳せ\n目を輝かせる龍馬
entries.en:
Ryoma's eyes
sparkled as he
dreamed of the
mighty foes he
had yet to meet.

entries.jp: そんな龍馬に高杉が\nため息をつき　桂が微笑む
entries.en:
At the sight of
Ryoma like
that, Takasugi
sighed, and
Katsura smiled.

entries.jp:
テラーダにいた頃と
変わらぬその空気の中
襖が開いて勝海舟が
姿を現した
entries.en:
In that same
old air from
their days at
the Terada, the
sliding door
opened and
Kaishu Katsu
appeared.

entries.jp: おっ　龍馬\n来ていたのか
entries.en: Oh, Ryoma. So\nyou're here.

entries.jp: 勝のおっさん！\n久しぶりじゃのう！
entries.en: Old Man\nKatsu! Been a\nwhile, ain't it!

entries.jp: おいコラ龍馬\n勝先生とお呼びしろ！
entries.en: Hey, Ryoma! Call\nhim Katsu-sensei!

entries.jp: まあいいじゃないか\nいやいやいや\nいいところにいてくれた
entries.en:
Ah, let it slide.
No, no, no, you
showed up at just
the right time.

entries.jp: ちょうど　お前に\n頼みたいことが\nあったのだ
entries.en:
There was
something
I wanted to
ask of you.

entries.jp: わしに頼み？
entries.en: Ask of me?

entries.jp: うむ　お前　この江戸で\n雷舞を演る気はねえか？
entries.en:
Mm. Say, how'd
you like to put
on a live right
here in Edo?

entries.jp: 何っ？　雷舞？\nやるやるっ！\nやるに決まってるぜよ！
entries.en: What? A live? I'm\nin, I'm in! 'Course\nI'm doin' it!

entries.jp: それはよかった\nでは　ぜひ雷舞を演って\nジュニアと戦って欲しい
entries.en:
Glad to hear it.
Then by all
means put on a
live, and battle
Junior for me.

entries.jp: ちょっと待ってくれ先生\nジュニアとってのは\nどういうことだ？
entries.en: Hold on a second,\nSensei. What's\nthis about Junior?

entries.jp: なかなか興味深い話ですね\n私達にも聞かせては\nもらえませんか
entries.en:
That sounds
rather intriguing.
Might we hear
the story as well?

entries.jp: もちろんだ　\n三人で舞台に上がって\nもらうつもりだったからな
entries.en:
Of course. I was
planning on
having all three
of you take the
stage anyway.

entries.jp: 日本最高のロックで\nジュニアに勝って欲しい
entries.en:
I want you to
beat Junior
with the finest
rock in Japan.

entries.jp: つまり勝たなければ\nいけない理由が\nあるということですか
entries.en: In other words,\nthere's a reason\nwe must win?

entries.jp: うむ
entries.en: Mm.

entries.jp: ジュニアはメリケンの使節\nなのだが　むちゃくちゃな\n条約を迫られて困っている
entries.en:
Junior is an envoy
from America, but
he's pressing an
outrageous treaty
on us, and we're
at our wits' end.

entries.jp: むちゃくちゃな条約？
entries.en: An outrageous\ntreaty?

entries.jp: あちらさんは日本中の\n港を開港して条約を結べと\n言って来ている
entries.en:
Their side's
demanding we
open every port
in Japan and
sign a treaty.

entries.jp: 悪いことだとは\n思えませんが
entries.en: That doesn't\nsound like a\nbad thing...

entries.jp: まあ聞け\n日本にとって良い条件も\nいくつかあるんだが……
entries.en:
Just hear me
out. There are
a few terms
that are good
for Japan, but...

entries.jp: 中には妙なものも\n混じっていてな
entries.en: Some strange\nones are mixed\nin there, too.

entries.jp: 妙な条件って\nどんなものなんですか？
entries.en: Strange\nterms? What\nsort of terms?

entries.jp:
日本中全ての女性に
すけすけの絹（シルク）の
着物（ドレス）を着せろ
……だそうだ
entries.en:
"Every woman in
Japan shall wear
a see-through
silk dress." ...Or
so he says.

entries.jp: ぶっ！\nな　なんだ　それは
entries.en: Pfft! Wh-what\nthe hell is that!?

entries.jp: ちなみにそれ……\n男の場合は\nどうなるんです？
entries.en: Incidentally...\nwhat happens in\nthe case of men?

entries.jp: 男の恰好なんてどうでも\nいいから　藁でも巻いて\n暮らせだとよ
entries.en:
He says he
couldn't care less
what men wear,
so they can wrap
themselves in
straw and live
like that.

entries.jp: 男の方が露出度高いじゃ\nねえか！
entries.en: The men end\nup showing\nway more skin!

entries.jp: 男は全員藁巻きか……\nラクじゃが　風邪を\n引きそうじゃな
entries.en:
Every man
wrapped in straw,
huh... Comfy, but
I reckon you'd
catch a cold.

entries.jp: オレ様は断固拒否するっ\n藁で股間を隠して\nロックがやれるかよ！
entries.en:
Yours truly flatly
refuses! How am
I supposed to
rock with straw
covering my
crotch!?

entries.jp: すけすけの着物って\n女性が許すはずが\nないでしょう
entries.en:
A see-through
kimono? Surely
no woman would
allow that.

entries.jp: う～ん\nジュニア様が言うなら\n考えちゃうわぁ
entries.en:
Hmm~ If
Junior-sama says
so, I might just
think about it~

entries.jp: あ　あんまり破廉恥なのは\nアレだけど　ジュニア様が\n言うなら……ねえ？
entries.en:
W-well, anything
too shameless is
kinda... you know,
but if Junior-sama
says so... right?

entries.jp: 同意します……
entries.en: I agree...

entries.jp: それでジュニア様にぃ\n見初められたりしてぇ～\nきゃっ♪
entries.en:
And then
Junior-sama
might faaancy
me~ Kyaa~

entries.jp: ……って\nおまえらは\nそれでいいのかよ！
entries.en: ...Wait, you're all\nfine with that!?

entries.jp: お　お登勢やん\nお龍達まで　いったい\nどうしたんじゃっ
entries.en:
O-Otose-yan?
Even Oryo
and the girls?
What's gotten
into you all!?

entries.jp: も　最早ジュニアのことで\n頭がいっぱいのようですね
entries.en:
I-it seems their
heads are already
full of nothing
but Junior.

entries.jp: 分かるか\n一事が万事この調子だ
entries.en: See what I mean?\nIt's like this with\neverything.

entries.jp: やつの行く先　若い娘から\n旦那持ちまで　女という女が\n付いて回る始末
entries.en:
Wherever he
goes, every
woman there
is, from young
girls to married
wives, follows
him around.

entries.jp: 家にすら帰ってこねぇ\n挙句に　男たちは\n泣き暮らしてる
entries.en:
They don't even
come home
anymore, and the
men spend their
days in tears.

entries.jp: このままではこの国を\n乗っ取られかねない\nいや冗談ではないんだ
entries.en:
At this rate, he
might just take
over the country.
No, I'm not joking.

entries.jp: こんな感じでジュニアは\n日本中の女性を虜にして\nしまっていてな
entries.en:
That's how Junior
has captivated
the women all
over Japan.

entries.jp: なんと……
entries.en: Well, I'll be...

entries.jp: わしが滝から落ちている\n間に　そんなことに\nなっておったんか
entries.en:
So all that
happened while
I was busy fallin'
off a waterfall?

entries.jp: まさかジュニアの影響力が\nそれほどまでとは\n思いませんでした……
entries.en:
I never imagined
Junior's
influence would
reach this far...

entries.jp: ああ　オレ様もだぜ
entries.en: Yeah. Neither\ndid yours truly.

entries.jp: ふぅむ\nそいつのロックは\nそんなに凄いのか……
entries.en: Hmm... His\nrock's really that\namazin', huh...

entries.jp:
きゃっきゃとはしゃぐ
お登勢達を見て
龍馬達はそれぞれに
表情を引き締めた
entries.en:
Watching Otose
and the girls
squeal with
excitement,
Ryoma and the
others each set
their faces.

entries.jp: 勝老中\n話は済んだ？
entries.en: Elder Katsu, are\nyou finished\ntalking?

entries.jp: はっ　慶喜様
entries.en: Ah,\nYoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: おお　ヨッシー！\nヨッシーも\n江戸に来てたのか
entries.en: Whoa, Yosshi!\nYou came to\nEdo too, Yosshi?

entries.jp: 久しぶりじゃなぁ！\n元気にしてたか
entries.en: Been a long time!\nYou doin' well?

entries.jp: お　おい　龍馬！\nお前はまた慶喜様に……
entries.en:
H-hey, Ryoma!
There you go
again with
Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: いいんだ\n予とお前たちは\n友達だもの
entries.en: It's all right.\nWe're all friends,\nafter all.

entries.jp: みんなも息災そうで\n何よりだよ
entries.en: I'm glad to see\nyou all looking\nso well.

entries.jp: わはははは\n滝から落ちても\n風邪一つ引いとらん
entries.en:
Wahahaha! I fell
off a waterfall
and didn't catch
so much as a cold!

entries.jp: 食べ過ぎで腹は一度\n壊したがな！
entries.en: Ate so much I\ngot a bellyache\nonce, though!

entries.jp: だから　テメェのバカを\n慶喜様にあまり晒すな！\n恥ずかしい！
entries.en:
That's exactly
why you shouldn't
show off your
stupidity to
Yoshinobu-sama!
It's embarrassing!

entries.jp: ふふ　\n龍馬は変わらないなあ
entries.en: Heh. You haven't\nchanged, Ryoma.

entries.jp: 慶喜は鷹揚に笑うと\nふっと真剣な眼差しになり\n龍馬達を見つめた
entries.en:
Yoshinobu
laughed
graciously, then
his gaze
suddenly turned
serious as he
looked at Ryoma
and the others.

entries.jp: それより\n勝老中から話は\n聞いたと思うけど
entries.en:
More importantly,
I believe you've
heard the story
from Elder Katsu.

entries.jp: ええ　\nどうやらまた大変なことに\nなっているようですね
entries.en:
Yes. It seems
things have
gotten serious
once again.

entries.jp: うん　予からも頼むよ\nどうかこの国を守って\n欲しい
entries.en:
Yes. I'm asking
you too.
Please, protect
this country.

entries.jp: 慶喜は三人に向かい\n深々と頭を下げた
entries.en:
Yoshinobu
turned to the
three and bowed
his head deeply.

entries.jp: そんな！　\n頭をお上げください！
entries.en: Please! Raise\nyour head!

entries.jp: ああ　慶喜様に頼まれ\nなくたって\nオレ達はやるぜ
entries.en:
Yeah. Even
without
Yoshinobu-sama
asking, we'd
do it anyway.

entries.jp: やってくれるか
entries.en: You'll do\nit for me?

entries.jp: わしに任せろ
entries.en: Leave it to me

entries.jp: 三人なら大丈夫
entries.en: The three of\nus got this

entries.jp: 楽しみじゃなあ
entries.en: Can't wait

entries.jp: わしに任せろ！
entries.en: Leave it to me!

entries.jp: さすがは龍馬だ\n頼りにしてるよ
entries.en: That's Ryoma\nfor you. I'm\ncounting on you.

entries.jp: 相手が本場じゃろうが\n何じゃろうが関係ない
entries.en:
Don't matter if
they're from the
home of rock or
wherever.

entries.jp: 日本の熱いロックを\n聴かせてやるぜよ！
entries.en: We'll let 'em\nhear Japan's\nred-hot rock!

entries.jp: ああ　その通りだぜ
entries.en: Yeah, damn right.

entries.jp: ええ\n頑張りましょう！
entries.en: Yes. Let's\ndo our best!

entries.jp: 三人なら大丈夫ぜよ
entries.en: With the three of\nus, we got this!

entries.jp: はっ　あんなヤツ\nオレ様一人でも\n十分だがな
entries.en:
Hah. Yours
truly could
handle that guy
all by himself.

entries.jp: シンディ～　\nそんな寂しいこと言わずに\n一緒にやるぜよ～！
entries.en:
Shindy~ Don't
say lonely stuff
like that! Let's
do it together~!

entries.jp: ええい　暑苦しい！\nくっつくな！\nクールじゃねえだろ！
entries.en:
Gah, you're
suffocating
me! Get off!
That's not cool!

entries.jp: ふふっ　\nまた騒がしい日々が\n戻ってきそうですね……
entries.en: Heh. It looks like\nour noisy days\nare coming back...

entries.jp: 楽しみじゃなぁ
entries.en: I can't wait!

entries.jp: けっ\n何をのんきなことを\n言ってやがる
entries.en:
Tch. What
carefree
nonsense are
you spouting?

entries.jp: でも　そのくらいの方が\n龍馬くんらしいですよ
entries.en: But being that\nway is exactly\nlike Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: 泥船に乗ったつもりで\n任せてほしいぜよ
entries.en:
Just feel as
safe as on a
mud boat and
leave it to me!

entries.jp: このバカ！\n泥船じゃ沈むだろ！
entries.en: You idiot! A\nmud boat sinks!

entries.jp: それじゃ\n黒船で！
entries.en: Then climb\naboard the\nBlack Ships!

entries.jp: それは敵の船ですよ\n龍馬くん
entries.en: Those are the\nenemy's ships,\nRyoma-kun.

entries.jp: と　とにかく\nダチの頼みなんじゃ
entries.en: A-anyway, a\npal's askin'\nme for help.

entries.jp: たとえ本場のロッカーが\n相手でも　負けるわけには\nいかん
entries.en:
Even if we're
up against a
rocker from the
home of rock,
we can't lose.

entries.jp: それにわしらだって\nロックへの愛では\n負けてないぜよ
entries.en:
Besides, when it
comes to lovin'
rock, we ain't
losin' to nobody!

entries.jp: はっ\nわかりきったことを\n言うんじゃねえ
entries.en: Hah. Don't state\nthe obvious.

entries.jp: ええ　そうですね\n私達だって日本の\n志士です
entries.en: Yes, that's right.\nWe are rebels of\nJapan too.

entries.jp: しかし本場のロックか\nどれほどすごいのか\n今からワクワクするなぁ
entries.en:
Still, real rock
from its
homeland, huh?
I'm already
itchin' to see
how amazin' it is!

entries.jp: 龍馬は……怖くないの？
entries.en: Ryoma... aren't\nyou scared?

entries.jp: うん？\n怖い？\nどうしてじゃ？
entries.en: Hm? Scared?\nHow come?

entries.jp: だって相手は民衆を\n一曲で虜にするような\nロッカーなのに
entries.en:
Because he's a
rocker who can
captivate the
people with a
single song.

entries.jp: 怖いというより\nワクワクするのう！
entries.en: More than scared,\nI'm downright\nexcited!

entries.jp: 龍馬のバカは\n突き抜けてるからな
entries.en: Ryoma's stupidity\njust goes clean\noff the charts.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんは強敵と\n戦えるのが楽しみ\nなんですよね
entries.en:
You're looking
forward to
fighting a strong
opponent, aren't
you, Ryoma-kun?

entries.jp: うむ　そん通りじゃ！\nわしらのロックを轟かせる\nいい機会ぜよ！
entries.en:
Yup, that's
exactly it! It's
a great chance
to make our
rock roar!

entries.jp: ああ　メリケン野郎に\n日本のロックを\n叩きこんでやる
entries.en:
Yeah. We'll pound
Japanese rock
into that
American bastard.

entries.jp: よしっ\nそうと決まったら\n練習じゃ！
entries.en: All right! Now\nthat it's settled,\nit's practice time!

entries.jp: ふん　修行の成果とやら\n見せてもらおうじゃねえか
entries.en:
Hmph. Let's
see these
results of your
training, then.

entries.jp: おうっ\nばっちり見せてやるぜよ！
entries.en: You bet! I'll\nshow ya plenty!

entries.jp: もたもたしてたら\n置いていくからな
entries.en: Dawdle and we'll\nleave you behind.

entries.jp: こっちだって遊んでた\nわけじゃねえんだ
entries.en: We weren't just\ngoofing off\neither, y'know.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんが修行に出ていた\n間に　私たちもずいぶんと\n練習しましたからね
entries.en:
While Ryoma-kun
was away
training, we
practiced quite a
lot ourselves.

entries.jp: おお　それは楽しみじゃ\nすっごい雷舞にするぜよ！
entries.en:
Ooh, now that's
somethin' to look
forward to! Let's
make it one heck
of a live!

entries.jp: 当たり前だ！\nオレ様を誰だと思ってる\nいつでも最高だぜ！
entries.en:
Obviously! Who
do you think
yours truly is? I'm
always the best!

entries.jp: シンディー
entries.en: Shindyyy!

entries.jp: や　やめろ\nテメェといるとオレ様の\nクールな魅力が台無しだ！
entries.en:
C-cut it out!
Hanging around
you ruins my
cool charm!

entries.jp: 別に高杉さんは……\nクールじゃないと\n思うけど……
entries.en:
Um, I don't
really think
Takasugi-san is...
cool, though...

entries.jp: いつだってぇ\n暑苦しいですぅ～
entries.en: He's always\nso stifliiing~

entries.jp: なんだと\nテメェらっ
entries.en: What'd you\nsay, you brats!?

entries.jp: まあまあ　晋作\n落ち着いて
entries.en: Now, now,\nShinsaku.\nCalm down.

entries.jp: はんっ
entries.en: Hmph.

entries.jp: そうなると\n龍馬達の江戸での拠点が\n必要になるだろう
entries.en:
In that case,
Ryoma, you and
your band will
need a base
here in Edo.

entries.jp: 雷舞までの練習には\nこの屋敷を使ってもらって\n構わんぞ
entries.en:
Feel free to use
this mansion to
practice until
the live.

entries.jp: 勝のおっさん\nありがとうな！
entries.en: Old Man Katsu,\nthanks a bunch!

entries.jp: お前達にはなんとしても\nジュニアに勝って\nもらわねばならんのだ
entries.en: You boys have\nto beat Junior,\nno matter what.

entries.jp: 予もできる限りの\nことをするよ
entries.en: I'll do everything\nI can, too.

entries.jp: おうっ
entries.en: You got it!

entries.jp: じゅにあに負けん\n熱いロックを\n聴かせてやるぜよ！
entries.en: We'll play red-hot\nrock that won't\nlose to Junior!

entries.jp: お登勢やん達もわしらを\n応援してくれるよな？
entries.en:
Otose-yan,
you and the
girls'll cheer
us on, right?

entries.jp: ええ～　\nどうしようかしら？
entries.en: Hmm~ now, what\nshould I do, dear?

entries.jp: へっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 龍ちゃん達も悪くないけど\nジュニア様は別格なのよね
entries.en:
You boys aren't
bad, Ryo-chan,
but Junior-sama
is in a league
of his own.

entries.jp: お　お登勢やん？
entries.en: O-Otose-yan?

entries.jp: 悪いけどアタシ達は\nジュニア様の贔屓倶楽部に\n入ったのよ
entries.en:
Sorry, but
we've joined
Junior-sama's
fan club.

entries.jp: だって……\n今はジュニア様しか\n見えないの……
entries.en:
Because... right
now, I only
have eyes for
Junior-sama...

entries.jp: だからぁ\nごめんなさぁい\n失礼しま～すぅ
entries.en: Sooo... sorryyy~\nWe'll be going\nnooow~

entries.jp: お　お登勢やん\nお龍　幾松……\nおうのまで……
entries.en: O-Otose-yan...\nOryo, Ikumatsu...\neven Ouno...

entries.jp: 彼女達はすっかり\nジュニアに心を奪われて\nしまっているようだな
entries.en:
It seems those
girls have
completely lost
their hearts to
Junior.

entries.jp: むむむ……なんだか\n悔しいぜよ
entries.en: Nnngh... that sure\nstings, I tell ya.

entries.jp: ふん　去ったヤツのことを\nどうこう言っても\nしかたねえ
entries.en: Hmph. No use\ngriping about the\nones who left.

entries.jp: でも　お登勢やん達は\nずっとわしらを応援して\nくれてたのに
entries.en:
But Otose-yan
and the girls
were always
cheerin' us on...

entries.jp: だったらオレ様達の\nロックで取り返せばいい\nそれだけのことだ
entries.en:
Then we just
win them back
with our rock.
Simple as that.

entries.jp: それじゃ\nさっすがシンディ！
entries.en: Now that's\nmy Shindy!

entries.jp: じゃあ\nさっそく練習を始めるぜ\nギターを出せ！
entries.en:
Then let's start
practicing right
away. Get your
guitar out!

entries.jp: いつでも準備は\nできてますよ
entries.en: I'm ready\nanytime.

entries.jp: おう！\nきたきたきたぜよ～っ！
entries.en:
Yeah! Here it
comes, here it
comes, here it
comeees!

entries.jp: 胸のうちから湧き上がる\n熱い火威斗！
entries.en: A red-hot beat\nwelling up from\ndeep in my chest!

entries.jp: さあ　歌うぜよ！\nわしらのロックを
entries.en: C'mon, let's\nsing! Our rock!

entries.jp:
ギターをかき鳴らし
龍馬がシャウトする
桂と高杉もそれに合わせ
勝海舟邸に熱いロックが
響いた
entries.en:
Ryoma strummed
his guitar and
shouted. Katsura
and Takasugi
joined in, and
red-hot rock rang
through Kaishu
Katsu's mansion.

entries.jp: 本場メリケンより襲来した\nペリージュニア
entries.en:
Perry Junior,
who had stormed
in from America,
the home of rock.

entries.jp: ジュニアとの対決へ向け\n三人の熱い日々が\n始まった！
entries.en:
With their
showdown
against Junior
ahead, the trio's
fiery days began!
